Publication statement: [China : s.n.], Qing Daoguang 26 nian [1846]
Shows a panoramic view of Wutai Shan with the famous Buddhist monastery.
Title in Chinese, Manchu, Mongolian, and Tibetan.

Wood block print on linen. Relief shown pictorially. Title in Chinese, Manchu, Mongolian, and Tibetan. Bird's-eye-view. Shows a panoramic view of Wutai Shan with the famous Buddhist monastery. Hummel purchase 1934, no. 9. Scale ca. 1:500. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy imperfect: portions washed away. AACR2: 700
